simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (H1018) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בֵּית הָאֵצֶל (Bêyth hâʼêtsel) means Beth-ha-Etsel , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Mic 1 11.

definitions.full: H1018. Beth Haetsel הָאֵ֫צֶל בֵּית proper name, of a location in Judah Micah 1:11 ; dubious, compare below אצל , p. 69.
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 681 with the article interposed; house of the side;
